div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Positive AND
low-risk native valve
AND good windows

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Negative or non-diagnostic
BUT suspicion persists

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Prosthetic valve, CIED,
S. aureus, new AV block,
or complication suspected

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(12, 42, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SUSPECT IE
Fever + murmur, or fever +
prosthetic valve / prior IE / IVDU,
or S. aureus bacteremia, or
embolic stroke of unknown source

div.style: color: rgb(12, 42, 82) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 SETS BLOOD CULTURES
Separate venipunctures, 10 mL/bottle
BEFORE antibiotics
(if stable - do not delay abx in sepsis)

div.style: color: rgb(8, 51, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TTE - first-line, within 24 h
Sens ~70% native / ~50% prosthetic
Spec ~90%

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 101) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(8, 51, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TEE - do it anyway
Sens ~96% native / ~92% prosthetic
Detects abscess, perforation, fistula

div.style: color: rgb(8, 51, 68) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(8, 51, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ADVANCED IMAGING - if still unclear
Cardiac CT: root abscess, pseudoaneurysm
18F-FDG PET/CT: prosthetic valve + CIED
(>3 mo post-op; low-carb prep diet)
WBC-SPECT/CT: alternative

div.style: color: rgb(92, 10, 28) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DEFINITE
Pathologic criteria, OR
2 major, OR 1 major + 3 minor,
OR 5 minor

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
REJECTED
Firm alternative dx, or resolution
with abx in under 4 days, or no path
evidence at surgery/autopsy
